Short description: AWS Lambda ingestion microservice failing for batch events.
Root Cause: Lambda runtime exceeded memory causing repeated cold starts.
Resolution: Increased memory to 1024MB and enabled provisioned concurrency.

Short description: SQS queue backlog growing beyond threshold for transaction pipeline.
Root Cause: Downstream Lambda consumer throttled due to burst traffic.
Resolution: Raised concurrency limit and added DLQ monitoring.

Root Cause: Faulty container image pushed without healthcheck endpoint.
Resolution: Rolled back to previous stable image.

Short description: Kinesis shard hot-spotting causing delayed event processing.
Resolution: Enabled enhanced fan-out and redistributed partition keys.

Short description: API Gateway 5xx spike impacting login microservice.
Root Cause: Expired IAM role credentials for Lambda authorizer.
Resolution: Rotated IAM keys and added automated expiry alarms.

Short description: AWS Glue ETL job failing during nightly batch load.
Root Cause: Corrupted parquet file in S3 landing zone.
Resolution: Added file validation and quarantine bucket.

Short description: Step Functions workflow timing out for order reconciliation.
Resolution: Added query pagination and increased timeout window.

Short description: DynamoDB table throttling during peak inventory sync.
Root Cause: Provisioned capacity too low for burst traffic.

Short description: Multiple IAM access denied errors for microservice deployment.
Root Cause: Incorrect IAM policy attached to CodeBuild role.
Resolution: Updated policy and added pre-deploy validation.

Short description: S3 event trigger not invoking reporting microservice.
Root Cause: S3 bucket notification misconfigured after migration.
Resolution: Recreated event trigger and validated SNS subscription.
